children.text: Step 1: Fill the prescribed application form and attach the disability certificate, income certificate, project estimate for the proposed work, and surety documents.
Step 2: Submit the completed application to the District Welfare Officer or Tehsil Welfare Officer for onward submission to the concerned authorities.

nodalDepartmentName.label: Department of Social Justice and Empowerment

basicDetails.schemeName: National Disabled Finance and Development Corporation

children.text: The applicant should be a resident of Himachal Pradesh.
The applicant should be an unemployed Person with Disability.
The applicant should have a disability of 40% or more, certified by a competent authority.
The applicant should have an annual income of less than ₹3,00,000 in rural areas or ₹5,00,000 in urban areas.

children.text: Loans of up to ₹25,00,000/- are provided for establishing various businesses at an interest rate of 5% to 8%, with an additional 1% interest concession for women with disabilities.

schemeContent.benefits_md: > Loans of up to ₹25,00,000/- are provided for establishing various businesses at an interest rate of 5% to 8%, with an additional 1% interest concession for women with disabilities.
schemeContent.briefDescription: The objective of this scheme is to make Persons with Disabilities self-reliant by providing loan facilities through the Himachal Pradesh Minority Finance and Development Corporation (Channelizing Agency) within the State for establishing self-employment ventures.

children.text: The Scheme "National Disabled Finance and Development Corporation", launched by the Department of Social Justice and Empowerment, Government of Himachal Pradesh, aims to make Persons with Disabilities self-reliant by providing loans for self-employment through the Himachal Pradesh Minority Finance and Development Corporation.
